I left the score blank. Step 2's 'Partially Answered' holds up when checked against the source text.

What the sheet establishes:
(1) BWSSB Act 1964, PRS text with amendments appended up to Act 29 of 2021. s.3(2) says the Board has 'not less than three and not more than nine members appointed by the State Government'. s.3(3) sets qualification-based seats: commercial/administration, two civil/public-health engineers, and accounting/finance. There is no ex-officio ULG seat. s.3(4) says the State appoints the Chairman. s.3(5) disqualifies any 'member of ... any local authority', and s.6(1)(d) lets the State remove a member who becomes or seeks to become one. So by law, elected ULG councillors cannot sit on the Board, and the top band (ULG-elected voting members) is ruled out.
(2) s.14 creates a Consultative Committee whose non-Board members are appointed after consulting bodies representing the 'Bruhat Bangalore Mahanagara Palike'. It is advisory only: s.14(4) says 'to advise ... to review'. It is not the governing Board, so I did not count it as Board representation.
(3) The ULG-side law runs the other way. The GBA Act 2024 (BWSSB-04) puts the BWSSB Chairman on the GBA (s.9(3)(h)) and on its Executive Committee (s.13(1)(g)). It does not give the GBA or the City Corporations a seat on the BWSSB Board. BWSSB-23 (GBA Amendment Bill 2025) changes only GBA ss.8 and 14 and says nothing about the BWSSB Board.

Why not 0: a 0 needs affirmative absence, and that is not established. s.3(5) bars elected local-authority members, but it does not bar ULG officials, such as a GBA or City Corporation Commissioner. The State could appoint such an official to a qualification seat. Meeting procedure, including any invitees, is left to Regulations under s.11 and s.88(1)(b). Members' terms are left to Rules under s.4. Neither the Rules, the Regulations, the gazette notification constituting the current Board, nor a current Board member list is in the Citation Sheet. The BWSSB website pages I checked (BWSSB-01, -07, -11, -12, -13, -16) show no Board list. So the non-voting/official/invitee band can be neither confirmed nor excluded.

Before BMLTA finalises 'any plan as under this Act' (for example the Comprehensive Mobility Plan), it 'shall' publish a draft and invite objections and suggestions from any person.
